<h2>Run the Shared sjSDM Tuning Sequence</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Orchestrates isolated unit and tier stores for exhaustive or staged tuning.
Staged execution alternates one cumulative unit round with one tier-wide
survivor target, then publishes the existing final tier artifact.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_tuning_sequence(
  unit_pipeline = NULL,
  tuning_target_names = NULL,
  unit_store_suffixes = NULL,
  prebuild_interpolation = FALSE,
  fresh_run = FALSE,
  tuning_strategy = NULL,
  n_rounds = NULL,
  run_pipeline_function = run_pipeline,
  vec_allowed_profile_roles = base::c("main", "smoke"),
  vec_allowed_profile_statuses = "active",
  has_tuning_evidence_function = has_sjsdm_tuning_evidence,
  target_store = load_active_config_value("target_store")
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="unit_pipeline">unit_pipeline</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar path to the unit pipeline script.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="tuning_target_names">tuning_target_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of public unit tuning-summary targets.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="unit_store_suffixes">unit_store_suffixes</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional character vector of isolated spatial-unit store suffixes. 'NULL'
runs one non-nested unit store, as used by temporal mapped pipelines.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prebuild_interpolation">prebuild_interpolation</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical forwarded to [run_pipeline()] for unit executions.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fresh_run">fresh_run</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical. When true, destroys unit stores on their first round and the tier
store before its first aggregation. Later rounds always resume.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="tuning_strategy">tuning_strategy</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar, '&quot;exhaustive&quot;' or '&quot;staged&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="n_rounds">n_rounds</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer configured repeat/tuning-round count.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="run_pipeline_function">run_pipeline_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable pipeline runner. Defaults to [run_pipeline()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vec_allowed_profile_roles">vec_allowed_profile_roles</code></td>
<td>
<p>Profile roles forwarded to [run_pipeline()]. Production callers should
retain 'c(&quot;main&quot;, &quot;smoke&quot;)'; dedicated runners authorize other roles.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vec_allowed_profile_statuses">vec_allowed_profile_statuses</code></td>
<td>
<p>Profile statuses forwarded to [run_pipeline()]. Production callers should
retain '&quot;active&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="has_tuning_evidence_function">has_tuning_evidence_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable fail-closed evidence checker. Defaults to
[has_sjsdm_tuning_evidence()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_store">target_store</code></td>
<td>
<p>Root targets-store path. Defaults to the active configuration value.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisible 'NULL'. Pipeline stores contain the durable results.
</p>

</main>
